snippet.title: SiN Reloaded Announcement Trailer | Nightdive Studios
snippet.description:
The long awaited cult classic FPS returns! Get ready to blast your way through SiN: Reloaded, fully remastered for PC and all consoles!

Experience the action packed story, unforgettable characters, and terrifying enemies with fully remade cinematic cutscenes, updated level layouts, rebalanced gameplay, along with high resolution textures, models, and lighting.

SiN: Reloaded will release on Xbox One, Series X|S, PlayStation 4|5, Nintendo Switch, and PC platforms this year!
===========================
Wishlist now:
Sony: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018113
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/sin-reloaded/9P0HZJTD8SG1
